data.name: Satyajit
data.gender_notes: Satyajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Satyajit is a combination of two Sanskrit words: ‘Satyam’ meaning truth and ‘Jit’ meaning victory. This name is associated with the god Rama, who is known for his truthfulness and strength. The name Satyajit carries the meaning “Truth, Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Satyajit usually hope their child will grow to embody truth, victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Satyajit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truth, Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Satyajit total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, Satyajit represents the individual's aspiration to overcome worldly obstacles through the power of truth. The name serves as a reminder to live in accordance with the truth and to remain steadfast in one’s beliefs and actions, ultimately leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
